book.name: HAWAVEMOGATALA
book.title: Yesu Keliso yana HAWAVEMOGATALA Yoni giꞋenoꞋitayena amanadi

content: Yaubada miBabiloni ginaluyaweyawelidi.

Tu kwamayoku adi nuwanuwa vaita melala lakahina amine gaꞋitadi-yo kadu lobama ana tovenuwaꞋata velugana lobama amine gihobuhobuꞋela-ma gaꞋitana. BanaꞋe ma yana waꞋabavehimeya lakahina ada yana mahalina veꞋakinamanamalina babi matatabuna gituvemahalina.
Au aimo gavadi ginalakayemu-ma faꞋina gikovaꞋawafatafata gigayo,

content.text: Medede againe Setani yana yoꞋo hiveꞋabaga,
MiBabiloni nuwanuwadi lakahina babi ana lokoloko
faꞋina fafali tulina tulina ana tonilokoloko

content: Au hidedemi tovenuwaꞋata kikaiwabuna gigahe.
Gigahe-yo agoꞋago velugana lobameya gikova-ma ganogalina gigayo,

content.text: yadi dewa koyona keke badi buye wanahuluvini,

content: Au hidedemi gahe ganogalina.
Kadu tovematahiwadi agaidiya gigahe gigayo,

content.text: higayo, Ime tokikaiwabu, vita keke anaꞋayauneni.
Hidedemi higahe faꞋina, aiyeta saꞋeyanaga againe

content: Au hidedemi kadu gahe ganogalina.
Tonilokoloko Babiloni ana ivebwavi faꞋina hinalulaukuhi.
Tu babi ana tokikaiwabu melalai-nadi ana dewa udoꞋudona kadu ana kikaiwabu hiꞋitavaina be buye hikoyo-ma melala ginaꞋalaꞋalata-ma siyona hinaꞋitana againe hinatagitagi hinalulaukuhi.
MiBabiloni yadi aulolo yadi vediwe faꞋina tokikaiwabu-dina hinamatautaveꞋine be hinamidilauva hinakova hinagayo,

content.text: Bai saꞋeyanaga againe adi matahiwadi hinuhagana.

content: Au hidedemi babi ana tokikaiwabu hinagahe.
Tu babi ana tonilokoloko melala ana ivebwavi faꞋina hinatagitagi hinalulaukuhi hinagayo, “Melala a gibwavi. Keke tamo hakwadi gidamiyami-yo yada lokoloko gidakimoneni faꞋina kanavekoyokoyo.

Yada lokoloko ma gola siliva kabala yamuyamumu-Ꞌowogidi kadu bidi fatana lakahina, kaleko tulina tulina kwayakwayana likelikena yabeyabelina wowobikabikana, higa wakalivadiyao adi vaigau. Kadu ai wamagana tulina tulina kadu ikilukiluma tulina tulina vaita manuwa ana vaigau faꞋina, gaitomai-dina tufona kevakeva halana againe hibubuna, kadu tufona ai fatana lakahina, tufona kofa, tufona kainumula, tufona kabala kwayakwayana hawahawaviyanina againe hibubudi.

Kadu yada lokoloko velugana ma gaitoma tulina tulina wamagana vaigau faꞋina, kadu vanedimodimo ana egana inisenisi mulo falanikisenisi, kadu oine, kadu bunama guwana ana egana olive againe hibubuna amanadi, kadu falawa be witi, kadu bulumakau be sifi, kadu hosi be waka abalulautaina. Kadu kaliva vevine vaita lokoloko amine akimokimonevedamanedi be kaliva adi agetoga faꞋina.” Au hidedemi tonilokoloko yadi lokoloko faꞋina hinagahe.

Kadu vaita miBabiloni-moꞋedi agaidiya hinagahe hinagayo, “Lokoloko tulina tulina nuwanuwami lakahina ma hiyawowola. Yami kikaiwabu yami giba veꞋakinamanamalina gihavaina, gihavai-moꞋena. Au aimo keke wanavai-havagiledi.”

Badi tonilokoloko lokoloko-dina melalai-nadi againe hikimokimonevedamanedi-yo hivewakalivadiyao amanadi hinamidilauva miBabiloni yadi vediwe faꞋina hinamatautaveꞋine. Hinatagitagi hinalulaukuhi hinagayo,

content.text: tu mena yami kikaiwabu gavatubuga ma

content: Au hidedemi tonilokoloko hitagilulauhawa.

Tu waka ana tovemadu kadu toyage, badi waka ana tofaisewa kadu badi fatadi faꞋina hivetobayauma-ma hinamidilauva melalai-nadi ginaꞋalaꞋalata-ma siyona hinaꞋitana againe hinakova hinagayo, “Hida hima melala ma keke tamo melala amine, keke-moꞋa.”
Au hitagitagi hilulaukuhi lokoloko hiluyauyaula hikovakova higayo,

content.text: Au bai saꞋeyanaga againe adi lauyawela hinuhagana.

content: Au hidedemi waka ana kaliva hitagilulauhawa.
Babiloni ana matahiwadi gavatubuga!
Tu tamo hakwadi gigahe gigayo,

content.text: Mena melala ana matahiwadi givaina faꞋina

content: Tu lobama ana tovenuwaꞋata fifiwalana kuga abokakaina vaita kugawauwaula amine gifewana be lehageya gihegehobuyena gigahe gigayo,

content.text: yadi wafaiwala hinaluyawelina be aimo keke wanaꞋitani.
Au keke tamo vemwamwala ana agoꞋago kananogalini,
Hida melala ana tonilokoloko ma boi
vaita babi ana kaliva kikaiwabudiyao amine.
E, gaveyao moyaꞋaidi fafali tulina tulina agaidiya
medema vaita dayagidi Babiloni againe gidamadu.

content: Au hidedemi tovenuwaꞋata fifiwalana gigahe.
